items.title: Lawrence "Buddy" Tureaud Interview, 1972-03-06
items.q: He played there at the time when I was a man. He was a house band.

ctx.x: Well, who else played at the Gypsy Tears? When did Kid Rene play there? He played there at the time when I was a man. He was a house band. He was a house band. Yes. And that, did he? Harold was playing with him. Harold was? He was playing saxophone.
How interesting. Did he have a small band? Seven Peas. Uh huh.
